title: Contents Packout & Storage Heavy-Box Charge for Large Boxes at Pack-Back
content:
Contents Packout & Storage large boxes are carried up as heavy boxes at the pack-back. On the pack-back box line of a return: **when the large box quantities on the job's packout lines total at least the heavy-box volume threshold, as many large boxes as that threshold carry the standard heavy-box charge and each large box beyond it carries the volume heavy-box charge; when they total at least one but fewer than the heavy-box volume threshold, each large box carries the standard heavy-box charge; a job with no large box carries no heavy-box charge.**

| Large boxes on the job's packout lines | Heavy-box charge |
|---|---|
| 60 or more (at least the heavy-box volume threshold) | 60 boxes at 1.25 (standard), plus each box beyond 60 at 0.95 (volume) |
| 1 to 59 | each box at 1.25 |
| none | none |

The boxes counted are the quantities on the large box (4.5 cubic feet) packing lines booked on the job.

## Boundary cases

| Large boxes | Heavy-box charge |
|---|---|
| 59 | 59 times 1.25, or 73.75 |
| 60 | 60 times 1.25, or 75.00 |
| 72 | 75.00 plus 12 times 0.95 (11.40), or 86.40 |
